senses.gloss: m.a shaft with a receptacle for a lamp, a plain candlestick Men. 28ᵃ ההוא פ׳ מקרי such a candlestick without branches is named pamoṭ (and not m’norah); Yalk. Ex. 369 פסוק (corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 44a:9">Sabb. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ שהדליקו עליו באותה שבת</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) a lampholder on which a lamp has been burnt on that (the present) Sabbath day. Y. ib. III, 6ᶜ top (also <cite ref="Q00251"><he>פומט</he></cite>), contrad. to <cite ref="N01255"><he>נר</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="Q00007"><he>פָּמוֹטוֹת</he></cite>. Bab. ib. 121ᵇ
